question:

TY-OT-JO

AF-VA-QV
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

TY-OT-JO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c15ffca333934443fb6632f48d1923aef6225869ad9436f881e87dfadac09f2.png] 

And,

AF-VA-QV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9512168ef502189596cc3a7b41eb13c0551a847ba23f7f8484ec1fe1f98db55.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) LQ-GL-CG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6af4eacd295265ff09418e0a5c5c27e8537ecd85b3825d140e7ccf26f6474cdc.png]
